name: zclass_typelist_update_bucket
description: zClass_TypeList::UpdateBucket walks a callback-priority type-list chain with deferred processing disabled, marks null-callback links pending, invokes active non-pending node callbacks, restores the deferred-processing flag, and flushes deferred work.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass type-list and node-callback source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x44eaa0 validates saving g_zClass_DeferredProcessingEnabled, clearing it during the walk, null-bucket handling, marking links with null node->actionCallback pending, skipping pending links, testing node flags bit 2 before indirect callback dispatch, restoring the deferred flag, and calling zClass::ProcessDeferredWork.

The native zClass smoke verifies that an active callback is invoked with deferred processing disabled, a null-callback link is marked pending, pre-pending and inactive links are skipped, the deferred flag is restored, and a null bucket still restores the disabled state.
